subject: Staged deployment credits, hotfix SLA and platform-fee amortization for Clearway
messages:
From: Priya Kothari <priya@clearwayhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Lindqvist <m.lindqvist@clearwayhealth.com>, procurement@clearwayhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-20T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Clearway RFP — VPC packaging questions and support expectations

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. Attached is our RFP and a short list of clarifying questions from procurement/engineering around private deployment packaging. High level asks:

- We need a clear split between the platform fee and node/operator licenses for our accounting team. Can you show an amortization option (12/24/36 months)?
- For support tiers: we need a defined hotfix SLA for production-impact incidents (P0/P1), and a way to credit/rescind fees if SLAs are missed.
- Pilot credit: we want a pilot (3 months) with discounted platform fees and limited operator licenses.
- Data residency, SOC 2 evidence and on-prem onboarding timeline.

Attached: Clearway_RFP_May2027.pdf

Can you route the pricing/detail response to procurement and copy your commercial lead? Procurement would like a single workbook that shows all amortization and pilot scenarios so they can run capex/opex comparisons.

Best,
Priya
Priya Kothari
VP Product, Clearway Health
priya@clearwayhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kothari <priya@clearwayhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearway RFP — VPC packaging questions and support expectations

Hi Priya — thanks for the RFP and clear list. Looping in David to finalize commercial constructs and Kimberly for packaging. High level response below; I'll attach a workbook with line-item scenarios.

Quick answers (summary):
- Platform fee vs operator licenses: we typically split as a platform fee (covers control plane, observability, and permitted amortized upgrades) + per-operator/site licenses for on-prem GPU nodes. In the attached workbook (Proposed_Onprem_Pricing_May27.xlsx) you will find columns for 12/18/24 month amortization scenarios.
- Pilot: we can offer a 3-month pilot at 25% off the standard platform fee and include 2 operator licenses for the pilot environment. Any additional operator nodes are billed at a discounted pilot rate.
- Hotfix SLA / credits: we support an addendum that defines severity, response timelines, and credits. Typical construct: SLA credit equals X% of monthly platform fee for each missed P0/P1 SLA, capped at Y% per quarter. We can provide precise language for legal to review (SLA_Hotfix_Addendum.docx attached).
- Compliance artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report, network diagrams, and onboarding runbook available; we will provide links and a redaction-friendly bundle for procurement.

Open items for alignment:
1) Amortization term you prefer (12/24/36) — earlier you mentioned preference for shorter amortization from treasury.
2) Exit protection: if you choose 12-month amortization with lower up-front, we typically require a 60-day notice and an off-ramp payment schedule.
3) Hotfix credit mechanics — procurement asked for a firm numeric cap vs. a percentage approach.

David — can you confirm the maximum quarterly credit cap we can offer for a commercial counter?

Priya — happy to set up a short call this week to walk procurement through the workbook.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Priya Kothari <priya@clearwayhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Lindqvist <m.lindqvist@clearwayhealth.com>, procurement@clearwayhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-25T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearway RFP — VPC packaging questions and support expectations

Marissa,

Appreciate the summary and workbook. A few clarifying asks after procurement reviewed:

- Amortization: Treasury is pushing for 12-month amortization for the platform fee if possible (they prefer capex recognition). If you can do 12 months, we need the exit protection to be limited — we can't accept large backstop payments.
- Hotfix SLA: procurement wants a deterministic credit schedule (e.g., $X per missed P0, $Y per missed P1) rather than % of platform fee. They argue it's simpler for audit.
- Pilot: 25% off is promising; can you include a one-time implementation credit to offset our internal onboarding cost? Even a small fixed credit will move the deal.

We also have a security question: for on-prem installs, how quickly do you commit to shipping security patches (hotfixes) that address verified critical vulnerabilities? We need a target window.

If you can send a commercial counter with explicit numbers (12-month amortization, firm credit per SLA miss, pilot implementation credit amount and hotfix commit window), procurement would be ready to move to a redline review.

Regards,
Priya
From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kothari <priya@clearwayhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearway RFP — VPC packaging questions and support expectations

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear asks. Apologies for the short delay; we've discussed internally and here's our commercial counter for DW-2027-0042. Below are firm numbers you can take into procurement/legal: 

1) Amortization & exit protection
- We can offer a 12-month amortization on the platform fee as requested.
- Exit protection: 30-day notice with a pro-rated final invoice; no multi-month backstop.

2) Pilot economics
- Pilot: 3 months at 25% off platform fee.
- Implementation credit: one-time $12,500 credit applied to the first invoice to offset your onboarding engineering costs.

3) Hotfix SLA and credits (on-prem installs)
- Target response / remediation: P0 acknowledged within 1 hour; remediation plan within 4 hours. P1 acknowledged within 2 hours; remediation plan within 24 hours.
- Deterministic credit schedule (per month): Missed P0 SLA = $7,500 credit; Missed P1 SLA = $1,500 credit. Credits apply against monthly platform fee, capped at 30% of that month's platform fee.
- We will accept a quarterly true-up with procurement if you prefer a max-dollar cap instead of percentage; we kept the cap to 30% to limit exposure.

4) Hotfix delivery commitment
- Critical security hotfix (verified exploit affecting confidentiality/integrity) — hotfix packaging and delivery within 14 calendar days for on-prem builds; emergency backport in 48 hours for showstopper exploits (agreed via incident response channel).

5) Compliance artifacts
- SOC 2 Type II and onboarding runbook link will be provided in a redaction-friendly bundle.

Attachments: Proposed_Onprem_Pricing_May27.xlsx (breaks down amortization scenarios) and SLA_Hotfix_Addendum.docx (legal ready language).

If that aligns we can push a term sheet and issue a preliminary DocuSign for the pilot/12-month amortization. Marissa/Kim — please flag any commercial/legal changes.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Commercials | Redwood Inference
david@redwood.com
